name: ASP Isotopes Inc.
blurb: ASP Isotopes Inc. is a development-stage advanced materials company focused on the production, distribution, and sale of isotopes, with operations in South Africa, Hong Kong, and the United States. It runs two segments: Nuclear Fuels, which develops technologies to produce high-assay low-enriched uranium (HALEU) and Lithium-6 targeting advanced nuclear reactor fuel markets; and Specialist Isotopes and Related Services. The company went public in November 2022 and, with approximately 271 employees and a market cap near $800 million, remains pre-profitability while pursuing a niche positioned squarely in the emerging advanced nuclear fuel supply chain.
recent: ASPI shares closed at $6.32 on May 13, 2026 — up ~5.9% on the day on volume of 6.3 million shares — though still well off the 52-week high of $14.49, sitting in the lower half of the $3.92–$14.49 annual range. Trailing twelve-month revenue grew roughly 476% year-over-year to $23.9 million, while the net loss widened to $175 million, reflecting heavy R&D and scaling costs. Analysts carry a consensus Strong Buy with a $12.00 price target (~90% upside), and the company is scheduled to report its next earnings on May 26, 2026.
